Same category, different company size. Choose Oracle Cloud HCM only if your buying job matches “Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM — modular enterprise suite (Global HR, payroll, talent, WFM); cust” rather than Paycor's shape. Choose Paycor only if your buying job matches “HR + payroll HCM (Paychex-owned since 2025) — custom quote; WISE AI. Landscape vs Gusto / ” rather than Oracle Cloud HCM's shape. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.
